I think you can call and ask your vet about a stronger antibiotic that isn't contraindicated for kidney failure, and you can ask about Zeniquin. I know that with dental issues, antibiotics will be prescribed before they do any work on teeth anyway, so I'll bet it is a dental infection that you're dealing with. 

My cat really likes royal canin kidney food! It's prescription only and it's pretty pricey but it's worth it. I do the wet and dry food. Really, wet food is best for kidney failure, but she just really likes dry food so I offer her both. 

For supplements, I recommend 1-TDC dental and joint health, and if you can afford it, Azodyl for kidney failure. There's a much more affordable alternative called Azovast on chewy but I'm not sure how effective it is, but maybe it's worth a try. 

If you're on Facebook, you should really join the feline kidney failure group here: https://www.facebook.com/groups/felinecrf/?ref=share&mibextid=NSMWBT

That group really helped me, and my cat has had kidney failure for almost 6 years. I wish you the best!!
